about.title: About ArtSora
about.intro: We turn iconic moments into premium framed art.
about.story: ArtSora started with a simple idea: the moments that shaped us — a legendary goal, an unforgettable song, a scene we can quote by heart — deserve a place on our walls. We produce museum-grade prints of football legends, music icons, and beloved series, finish them in hand-crafted golden frames, and deliver them ready to hang.
about.craftText: Every frame is finished by hand with premium materials, built to make the artwork the hero of any room.
about.authenticText: High-resolution printing on quality stock, with colors that stay vivid for years.
about.deliveryText: Careful packaging and nationwide delivery — your frame arrives safe and ready for the wall.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about ordering, shipping, and our frames
faq.a1: Orders are prepared within 1–2 business days and typically delivered within 2–5 business days depending on your governorate. You'll see the estimated time for your area at checkout.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We accept cash on delivery, Vodafone Cash, and InstaPay. You choose your preferred method at checkout.
faq.q3: Can I order a custom frame with my own image?
faq.a3: Yes — contact us on WhatsApp with your image and preferred size, and we'll craft a custom frame for you.
faq.a4: Most designs come in multiple sizes, shown on each product page. If you need a size you don't see, reach out and we'll help.
faq.q5: What if my frame arrives damaged?
faq.a5: Every frame is packed with protective layers. If anything arrives damaged, send us a photo within 48 hours and we'll replace it free of charge.
faq.q6: Can I return or exchange my order?
faq.a6: Yes — returns and exchanges are accepted within 30 days for items in their original condition. Custom frames can only be exchanged if damaged or misprinted.
